description: This file defines API route handlers for searching channels and boards within a team or globally, including permission checks, search logic, and response formatting.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API struct that contains methods for handling search-related API endpoints.

methods.name: registerSearchRoutes
methods.description: Registers search-related HTTP routes to the provided mux.Router.

methods.name: handleSearchMyChannels
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch user channels within a team, with optional search filtering.

methods.name: handleSearchBoards
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search for boards within a team based on a search term and field.

methods.name: handleSearchLinkableBoards
methods.description: Handles GET requests to find boards in a team that the user can manage roles for, based on a search term.

methods.name: handleSearchAllBoards
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search for boards across all teams based on a search term.
